001package dev.nandi0813.api.Utilities;
002
003import lombok.Getter;
004import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
005import net.kyori.adventure.text.format.NamedTextColor;
006
007@Getter
008public class PlayerNametag {
009
010    private final Component prefix;
011    private final NamedTextColor colorOfName;
012    private final Component suffix;
013    private final int sortPriority;
014
015    public PlayerNametag(Component prefix, NamedTextColor colorOfName, Component suffix, int sortPriority) {
016        this.prefix = prefix;
017        this.colorOfName = colorOfName;
018        this.suffix = suffix;
019        this.sortPriority = sortPriority;
020    }
021
022}
